title: Bridge and Letter
author: Kestrel Brightwater
blurb: Felix Oyelaran, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
